versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the skill for monitoring brand sentiment across Twitter, Reddit, and TikTok simultaneously.
- Combines parallel platform scraping, sentiment classification, and cross-platform health scoring into a unified workflow.
- Returns per-platform sentiment breakdowns, overall health score (0–100), top positive/negative posts, and theme analysis.
- Supports customizable search filters and engagement-weighted sentiment analysis per platform.
- Designed for brand managers, CMOs, PR, and reputation monitoring teams.
